units.rhetorical_move: names the threat and the three jobs
units.function: opens by saying what the paper will measure

features.clause_structure: a while clause then a to-better sentence
original_instantiations: the threat is named and three jobs are promised
no number is given yet

units.source_excerpt: The plastic waste pollution, is posing a great threat to the global ecosystem and human health
units.reusable_pattern: name the threat and then the three jobs the paper will do

units.rhetorical_move: walks the bearing model in three steps

original_instantiations: the safe level is reached by a load, a capacity and the point where they meet
the point is named as equality

units.source_excerpt: Firstly, the relationship of disposable plastic waste and Environmental Bearing Quantity (EBQ) are given
units.reusable_pattern: preview a ceiling as three ordered steps ending at an equality

units.rhetorical_move: checks the forecast on one country
units.function: gives the check before the global number

features.clause_structure: a to-verify sentence with one figure
original_instantiations: one country is said to fall to a small share, close to the official figure
the check is one sentence

units.source_excerpt: we apply it to Ireland and the results are the disposable plastic waste rate in total waste will decrease to 0.3%
units.reusable_pattern: check a forecast on one country and one official share
prohibited_generalizations: the share is this paper's check

units.rhetorical_move: states the global target as one mass in one year

original_instantiations: the smallest global waste is given as a mass and a year
the mass is the result

units.source_excerpt: the minimal achievable level of global waste of disposable plastic is 15.88 million tones till 2030
units.reusable_pattern: report a target as a mass and a year
prohibited_generalizations: the spelling is this summary's and should be kept

units.rhetorical_move: sorts the unfairness into two facts and four remedies

original_instantiations: the unfairness is two uneven facts, and four remedies are named
only one remedy is spelled out

units.source_excerpt: The unfair problems of the global plastic waste crisis are mainly reflected in the uneven distribution
units.reusable_pattern: close by sorting the unfairness and naming the remedies

units.rhetorical_move: puts the products in ordinary life

features.clause_structure: a referred-to sentence with a list
original_instantiations: the products are listed as ordinary objects and then the harm is turned on
the list comes first

units.source_excerpt: Single-use plastics products, referred to as items intended to be used only once before thrown away, are almost everywhere in our life
units.reusable_pattern: open by listing the ordinary objects and then turning

units.rhetorical_move: puts two cited damages behind the threat
units.function: gives the ocean a size and a cost

features.clause_structure: a since sentence with two citations
features.quantitative_role: a mass range and a money figure
original_instantiations: the ocean is given a yearly mass and one region is given a yearly cost
both figures are borrowed

units.source_excerpt: Effects can be seen by the approximately 4-12 million tons of plastic waste that enter the oceans each year
units.reusable_pattern: back a threat with a borrowed mass and a borrowed cost
prohibited_generalizations: the figures belong to the cited sources

units.rhetorical_move: says the forecast has barely been studied
units.function: turns the background into a gap

original_instantiations: the interventions are granted and the missing forecast is the gap
the gap is the close

units.source_excerpt: However, there are little research about the prediction of disposable plastic waste
units.reusable_pattern: close a background by naming the study that is missing
prohibited_generalizations: the grammar is this paper's and should be kept

units.rhetorical_move: lists the required tasks as bullets
units.function: turns the prompt into four jobs

original_instantiations: four tasks are each given a bullet
the list is the plan

units.source_excerpt: What we need to do is as follows
units.reusable_pattern: restate the tasks as a bullet list

units.rhetorical_move: says each assumption is justified

original_instantiations: the list is announced and each item is said to be justified
the justification is promised

units.source_excerpt: To simplify the cost benefit analysis model, this paper makes following basic assumption, each of which is properly justified
units.reusable_pattern: announce an assumption list as already justified
prohibited_generalizations: the model name in the sentence is this paper's

units.rhetorical_move: drops the growth of capacity

original_instantiations: capacity is held still because the recovery is said to be slow
the reason is the assumption

units.source_excerpt: We assume that the increase in Environmental Bearing Capacity can be ignored because the evolution of the ecosystem is a long-time process
units.reusable_pattern: hold one stock still and give the reason

units.rhetorical_move: points at the symbol table
units.function: keeps the definitions out of the prose

original_instantiations: the symbols are said to be in the table
the sentence carries no definition

units.source_excerpt: We list the symbols and notations used in this paper in Table 1
units.reusable_pattern: send the symbols to a table
prohibited_generalizations: the sentence is a pointer, not a definition

units.rhetorical_move: keeps only two sources

original_instantiations: only bags and foam are kept, and each is given a symbol
the cut is the point

units.source_excerpt: To simplify our model, only two sources of the waste mentioned above is considered
units.reusable_pattern: cut a waste down to two named sources
prohibited_generalizations: the grammar is this paper's and should be kept

units.rhetorical_move: ranks the disposal paths by harm
units.function: borrows a preference before the figure

original_instantiations: one path is preferred to two others, and a figure is promised
the ranking is borrowed

units.source_excerpt: Scientifically speaking, energy recovery processes are preferable to landfilling or improper forms of disposal
units.reusable_pattern: rank the paths by a borrowed preference and then show them

units.rhetorical_move: grants that a system repairs itself

original_instantiations: repair is granted so long as the damage stays under a threshold
the threshold is the point

units.source_excerpt: As we all know, ecosystems are capable of self-regulating
units.reusable_pattern: grant a repair and then name the threshold that ends it

units.rhetorical_move: defines capacity as the threshold of the load

original_instantiations: capacity is restated as the load the system can still take
an example follows

units.source_excerpt: In other words, EBC is the threshold of EBQ
units.reusable_pattern: restate a capacity as the threshold of the load

units.rhetorical_move: says the rate must stay under one

original_instantiations: safety is the rate held under one, and the ceiling is the rate equal to one
the equality is the ceiling

units.source_excerpt: To sum up, to safely mitigate the plastic waste without further environmental damage, the value of EBR must be controlled under 1
units.reusable_pattern: define a safe level as a rate held at one

units.rhetorical_move: sends the reader to a figure of the loads

original_instantiations: the loads are said to be in the figure
the formulas come after

units.source_excerpt: To embrace a more detailed description of the measurements of EBQ, pay attention to Fig.5
units.reusable_pattern: send the reader to a figure before the formulas

units.rhetorical_move: says equality of the rate gives the ceiling

original_instantiations: the ceiling is said to follow once the rate equals one
the waste itself is not written out

units.source_excerpt: When EBR equals 1, we can get the maximum levels of single-use plastic products that can be safely reduced
units.reusable_pattern: claim a ceiling from setting a rate equal to one

units.rhetorical_move: drops a heavy fit for a straight line

original_instantiations: the full fit is called too heavy and a regression is put in its place
the reason is the work

units.source_excerpt: Therefore, we choose Multiple Linear Regression and Least Squares Difference Method to simplify it
units.reusable_pattern: drop a heavy fit and name the lighter one
prohibited_generalizations: the method name is this paper's and should be kept

units.rhetorical_move: reads the error off the check

original_instantiations: the error is given as one percentage and the model is called effective
the percentage is the proof

units.source_excerpt: In fact, the Relative Mean Square Deviation is just 4.2%, which demonstrates the effectiveness of the model
units.reusable_pattern: close a check by one error percentage

units.rhetorical_move: reads the radar as agreeing with the earlier split

original_instantiations: coastal places are said to respond more on burning, and richer places more on a ban
the chart is the evidence

units.source_excerpt: the policy is more effective in coastal countries than landlocked ones
units.reusable_pattern: read a chart as confirming an earlier split of countries

units.rhetorical_move: sets the target from a figure

original_instantiations: the target is a mass, under the assumption that the policy holds
the assumption is named

units.source_excerpt: Therefore, we set the targeted level as 15.88 Million tones, based on the assumption that policy of limiting disposable plastic won't change
units.reusable_pattern: set a target as a mass and name the assumption it needs
prohibited_generalizations: the spelling is this paper's and should be kept

units.rhetorical_move: sets two disposal shares

original_instantiations: one share is set to fall and another to rise
the pair is the mix

units.source_excerpt: we set the targeted percentage of plastics into ocean declining to 18% and the percentage of plastics incinerated increasing to 65%
units.reusable_pattern: report a target mix as one share falling and one rising
prohibited_generalizations: the pair is this paper's target

units.rhetorical_move: states two declines from the policies

original_instantiations: production is said to fall by one share and the exhaust by another
a third share is the ocean

units.source_excerpt: the amount of production will decrease by 55%
units.reusable_pattern: report an impact as two named declines

units.rhetorical_move: reads the map as a wide gap

original_instantiations: one country is given a large share and others a share near zero
the gap is called unfair

units.source_excerpt: the share of mismanaged waste in China is 27.7%, while that in some countries is less than 0.1%
units.reusable_pattern: read a map as one large share against a share near zero

units.rhetorical_move: says the two errors are close

original_instantiations: the held-out error is said to sit only a little above the fitted error
the closeness is the proof

units.source_excerpt: the Cross-Validation Error is only slightly higher than the Testing Set Error, demonstrating the robustness of the model
units.reusable_pattern: call a model robust because two errors sit close

units.rhetorical_move: bounds the noise the result can take

features.quantitative_role: a noise level and a deviation
original_instantiations: below one noise level the result stays inside a stated deviation
the pair is the proof

units.source_excerpt: when the standard deviation of gaussian noise is no more than 0.6, the relative deviation of the results does not exceed 20%
units.reusable_pattern: bound a result by the noise it can take

units.rhetorical_move: addresses the council and names the target

original_instantiations: the council is addressed and the target is offered as the subject
the salutation comes first

units.source_excerpt: Dear ICM, we are honored to describe the realistic global target of single-use plastic waste for you
units.reusable_pattern: open a memo by offering the target to the reader

units.rhetorical_move: states the mass and the two shares

original_instantiations: the year is given a mass, a falling ocean share and a rising burn share
the three figures are the advice

units.source_excerpt: a realistic target for the annual amount of production of global single-use plastics in 2030 is 15.88 Million tones
units.reusable_pattern: state a target as a year, a mass and two shares

units.rhetorical_move: uses one country as the obstacle
units.function: warns that a law can fail

original_instantiations: one country is said to have kept a strict limit and still not cut the waste
the example is the warning

units.source_excerpt: Take the country, Bangladesh as an example, although strict limits had been released on plastic, the single-use plastic waste has not declined significantly
units.reusable_pattern: warn with one country where a strict limit did not cut the waste

units.rhetorical_move: claims the data are official

original_instantiations: the data are called rigorous because they come from official places
the credit is the claim

units.source_excerpt: The data are from official website and official journal, which is relatively rigorous
units.reusable_pattern: claim rigor from the kind of source

units.rhetorical_move: claims the equity remedies come from economics
units.function: joins the model to a field

original_instantiations: the remedies are said to come from joining the model to economics
the join is the claim

units.source_excerpt: Through the combination of the established mathematical model and the knowledge of economics, we have proposed feasible solutions
units.reusable_pattern: claim a remedy by joining the model to another field

units.rhetorical_move: admits the missing data still bias the model

original_instantiations: the missing values are said to remain even after a treatment
the remainder is the limit

units.source_excerpt: Although we try to use appropriate methods to deal with missing values, the lack of real data still affects the model
units.reusable_pattern: own a gap that a treatment did not close

units.rhetorical_move: admits disasters are left out

original_instantiations: disasters are left out and the bias is named
the omission is the limit

units.source_excerpt: Our model does not take the natural disasters into account, so there is bias in our analysis
units.reusable_pattern: own a left-out cause and the bias it leaves
prohibited_generalizations: the grammar is this paper's and should be kept

units.rhetorical_move: lists the sources as numbered lines
units.function: shows which claims rest on a source

original_instantiations: each source is given its own numbered line
the list mixes articles and web pages

units.source_excerpt: Production, use, and fate of all plastics ever made
units.reusable_pattern: give each source its own numbered line
